function: Excluded (function): learned neural codebook only quantizes already-precoded signals for capacity-limited fronthaul (p. 2, Fig. 1 caption; p. 8); no detection, estimation, precoder design or other area.
notes: Exclusion reason: function. Codes 1-4 and 7 do not apply: research article, learned component (neural codebook trained with Adam, p. 10), lower-PHY level, quantitative results (pp. 10-13). The problem solved is precode-and-compress fronthaul quantization. p. 2, Fig. 1: 'All baseband processing is done at the DU, which carries out compression of the baseband signals for transmission over capacity-limited fronthaul links'. p. 2: 'our work also complements studies on precoding designs'. The precoder is fixed MMSE, p. 10: 'we adopt MMSE precoding and localized MMSE receive beamforming'. Borderline point for the reviewer: p. 10 calls the unquantized optimized-signal benchmark 'a type of non-linear precoding' and p. 11 shows neural-MQ approaching it, but the learned function stays the quantizer, not the precoder. Not graded for an exclusion: channels follow 3GPP TR 38.901 UMi (p. 11, Fig. 5 caption) and code is at https://github.com/kclip/scalable-MQ (p. 10, footnote 1).
